text: Coffee with Alana. Her daughter's piano recital is Saturday 7 November 2026 at 2pm in the church hall. She's been practising Chopin every night and is terrified. Alana says the dog has started howling along, which isn't helping. Her husband Kofi is away with work that week so it's just her and the grandparents. I said I'd try to come along if I can swap my shift.
Noor and Hemi have tickets for the Fontaines gig in March 2027. They booked it for their anniversary. Noor's also training for a 10k sometime in the spring but won't commit to a date.
Dry cleaning ready Thursday after 4. Car MOT on 2 November 2026 at 9am, then pick up stamps on the way back.
Kofi rang. His brother Reza is running the Manchester marathon in April 2027, first one ever. Kofi reckons he's under-trained and a bit panicky about it. Should text Reza good luck the night before.

Long catch up with Eli at lunch. He's moved to the night desk at the paper and hates the hours. His partner Dev is doing stand-up for the first time at the Crown on Friday at 8. Eli asked if I'd come. I'm going, already told him.
Neha's netball team made the regional final, 14 November 2026, tip off half 10. She plays wing defence. Her mum's driving up from Leicester to watch.
Yuki - vegan, allergic to cashews. Big into bouldering.
Ali's band gig at the Lexington was cancelled because the venue flooded. They're trying to rebook for sometime after Christmas. Ask Ali if they've found a new date.
Kemal mentioned his dad's 70th is in January. Big family dinner. Kemal wants to get him a proper fountain pen, his old one got lost on holiday.
Olivia's school play is The Wind in the Willows, she's Ratty! Performances 3 and 4 December 2026, 7pm both nights. She's nervous about the songs. Get flowers for the opening night.
Tomás and Laura are doing the Bristol half on Sunday morning. Laura's knee has been playing up since the summer so she might walk bits. Tomás is aiming for under 1:45.
Need to renew passport before March 2027. Photo booth at the post office, then forms.

Victor (Vic to everyone) is playing cello in the orchestra's winter concert, 12 December 2026 at half 7. He's second chair now. His wife Farah is organising the raffle. Their son Kemal is turning the pages for him, which is very sweet. Vic's been rehearsing every evening and the neighbours have started complaining.
Saw Dong at the allotment yesterday. He's entering his marrows in the village show in August. Takes it very seriously, has a spreadsheet.
Kiri's audition for the Royal Academy went really well apparently, results soon. Find out if she got in.
Quick one: Isla's cat Pickle went missing on Monday, still not back. She's put posters up everywhere. Check in with her tomorrow evening.

Esther's husband had his hip op last week, home now but grumpy. She's covering all the school runs and sounded exhausted. I'm doing their shopping on Saturday. Should drop round a lasagne too. Her eldest, Kiri, has mocks after half term too, so the house is chaos. Esther joked she hasn't sat down since Tuesday.
Yosef and his wife are off to Lisbon for New Year. Back on the 4th. He's learning Portuguese on an app, 200-day streak.
Rafael is pitching to the board on Tuesday at 11. He's done the deck three times. Don't forget to message him Tuesday morning.
Aurelio Costa from work is retiring at the end of the year after 31 years. Leaving do is 18 December 2026, 5pm at the Anchor. Chris is collecting for a present, chip in.
Chris said Zainab got the head of maths job! Starts after Easter. She's buzzing. Card for Zainab this week.

Dorota's son Leon has his grade 5 trumpet exam on the 19th at quarter past 10. He's been really anxious and Dorota's been sitting in on practice to calm him. She's also starting a pottery class in the new year. Leon wants to quit after grade 6 and switch to drums, which Dorota is not thrilled about.
Asha - lives in Hove now, flat by the station. Works in UX at a bank. Hates coriander.
Rahul's cricket club are in the indoor league final Thursday night. He's captain this season. Text him after to see how it went.
Book dentist sometime next month. Also sort the gutters before the weather turns.

Bumped into Alana and Kofi at the farmers market. They're engaged!! Wedding probably summer 2027, somewhere in Cornwall. Kofi already talking about a ceilidh band. Alana said her sister Amy is doing the flowers. They're thinking of a date in late June, after Alana's exams finish. Kofi's mum apparently already bought a hat. Honestly the happiest I've seen them in ages.

Noor phoned this morning. Her grandma passed away on Sunday, funeral is Friday 30 October 2026 at 1pm. She was really close to her. Send Noor a card and maybe call her at the weekend. She's flying back to Lahore with her mum on Sunday for a couple of weeks.
Hemi's in a choir now, they perform at the cathedral on 21 December 2026 at 6. He asked if anyone wants tickets, I said yes for two. He's also got a new puppy, a collie called Biscuit.
Amy has a thing about vintage typewriters, owns four. Birthday's 9 February. Mentioned she'd love ribbons for the Olivetti, apparently impossible to find.
Reza's flatmate moved out so he's looking for someone soonish. Rent's going up in January too. He seemed fed up.
Did the big shop. Freezer's full. Bins out Wednesday night, recycling next week.
Eli's sister Kiri passed her driving test this morning, third attempt. Eli's mum cried apparently. Congratulate Kiri.
Neha's starting a PhD in marine biology in September 2027, Plymouth. She's slightly nervous about the money. Her boyfriend Tomás might move down with her.
Yuki's dad is having a scan on Monday at 8.30am. She's taking him. Ring Yuki Monday afternoon to see how it went.
Ali and his wife Laura had the baby! Little boy, born Saturday night, 3.6kg. Everyone's fine. Laura's mum is staying with them for a fortnight.
Kemal is doing a charity boxing match in the spring, white collar thing. He's never boxed before and admits he's scared. Training three times a week. His boss is sponsoring him £100.

Olivia says Victor and Farah split up over the summer. Farah's moved into her sister's for now. She's okay-ish but struggling with the kids' routines. Should invite Farah for dinner sometime soon, without making it weird. Victor's taken the flat and has the kids every other weekend. Olivia thinks it's been coming for a while.

Chat with Tomás after five-a-side. His job at the council is being restructured, redundancy meetings on 9 November 2026 at 3pm. He's fairly calm about it, says he's been looking anyway. Has an interview at a housing association the week after. I said I'd look over his CV tonight.

Dong's daughter is in a ballet competition in Birmingham, Saturday 28 November 2026, on stage around 11. Dong and his wife are driving up the night before and staying over. She's been dancing since she was four.

Don't forget to buy a birthday card for Isla, her birthday's the 2nd. She's turning 40 and pretending she doesn't care. Her partner Leon is throwing a surprise party on Saturday 31 October 2026 at 8. Leon's asked me to keep her busy until about half seven, so I'm taking her for a drink at the Swan first. Must not mention anything to Isla's sister Amy, she cannot keep a secret.
Esther's off to Japan in the spring, three weeks, mostly Kyoto. She's been saving for ages. Recommend that ramen place to her.
Dev Kowalski - Eli's partner. Teaches A level chemistry. Does stand-up on the side. Massive Arsenal fan.
Yosef's mum is moving into a care home in Leeds next month. He's finding it really hard, lots of guilt. Brother's no help. Check in with Yosef next week.
Rafael's wedding was postponed, his fiancée's dad is ill. They're hoping for sometime in 2027. Rafael's being stoic but I think he's gutted.
Aurelio and his wife celebrate 40 years married on 15 January 2027. Their kids are planning a meal. Aurelio hinted he'd love a framed print of the old harbour.
Zainab's running the Great North Run next September. Raising money for the hospice that looked after her dad. Sponsor her.
Dorota (Dot) told me she's been made partner at the firm. Announced in December, officially from 1 January 2027. She's taking everyone out for drinks after Christmas.

Grabbed a coffee with Asha and Rahul after the gig on Thursday. Asha's playing bass in a new band now, first show is the 13th at half 8 at the Brunswick. Rahul's going with his brother Sam. Asha seemed nervous but excited. I should go to that too, and message her the day before.
Leon's mum has her cataract operation on Wednesday 4 November 2026, first thing. He's driving her in and taking the day off. Message Leon Wednesday evening.
Renew car insurance, it runs out 11 December 2026. Compare quotes at the weekend.
Alana's brother Hemi is doing the Three Peaks challenge in June, raising money for mental health. He's also just started at a new architecture firm in town. Alana thinks he's overdoing it a bit.

Noor - coeliac. Loves crime podcasts, currently on a true crime about a Welsh farm. Has a rabbit called Fudge. Friend Rafael got him a mock interview last week which helped a bit. His girlfriend Asha is taking him for dinner afterwards whatever happens.
Kofi's interview at the BBC is Monday at 10am. Third round. He was shaky on the phone, really wants this one. Remind me to text him Sunday night, then ring him Monday after lunch to hear how it went.
Victor said his little girl starts nursery in January. He and Farah are sharing drop-offs. She's already got a tiny backpack.
Amy and Eli went to see Hamlet at the Globe last night, said it was incredible. Amy wants to go again before it closes in the new year. Eli fell asleep in the second half apparently.

Long call with Isla. She's not sleeping, work's awful, her manager keeps moving deadlines. She has a performance review on 25 November 2026 and is dreading it. Her girlfriend Neha has been brilliant. Also she's thinking about getting a dog in the spring, maybe a greyhound. Ring her the day after the review.
Hemi's daughter got into Bristol for medicine! Starts next autumn. Whole family's over the moon, they're having a party on Saturday 14 November 2026 at 7. I'm bringing dessert.
Kemal said Laura has a new job at the hospital, radiographer, started last Monday. She's settling in fine. They've moved to a bigger flat near the park.
Gym Monday, Wednesday, Friday mornings at 7 from next week. Meal prep Sundays.

Olivia's nan turns 90 on 6 March 2027. Big do at the golf club, the whole family's flying in from Canada. Olivia's making a photo book. Ask Olivia if she wants old photos of the nan from the 2019 trip.
